justification.ssot_completeness: Records both key policies with their supersede (S5 where missing-key 'abolished'; S6 'old S3 empty-search guard ... abolished') and the pipeline order, but no goals/product or early-feature history.
justification.authority_clarity: Implicit supersede language only; self-disclaims authority and gives no precedence-vs-latest-chat rule.
justification.update_correctness: Matches the final code (blank -> list mode; where missing-key -> non-match -> []).
justification.no_fake_certainty: Grounded with careful edge notes (e.g. where={k:None} only matches items with k set to None); nothing invented.
justification.reuse_value: Records the blank supersede so a next agent has the history; usable with effort, no authority framing.
